keyed.HH.Underworld.GateClosed: Not available: the underworld is closed in this game.
keyed.HH.Underworld.BackRoomDoorInfo: Only staff, colonists and shady guests can open this door.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Stranger.Title: A stranger at the gate
keyed.HH.Underworld.Stranger.Text:
A stranger with his hat low waits outside your door until the staff are out of earshot.

"Nice place," he says. "Got a back room?"

He does not say what he means by that. He does not need to.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Unlocked.Title: The back room
keyed.HH.Underworld.Unlocked.Text: You showed him the back room, and he nodded as if you had passed a test. A new line of research is open to you: the back room, with doors, a fight pit, a fence's counter, a smuggler's dock and a lounge. Your Whispers (the reputation in the underworld) will now follow what you build.\n\nYou can ignore all of it. Nothing here is required.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Warn.Title: Content warning
keyed.HH.Underworld.Warn.Dark:
Dark content adds to the underworld: prisoners may fight to the death in the pit, gangs may question prisoners harder, hunters may hunt prisoners (with a fitting ideology), and a clinic counter buys harvested organs.

It appears as text and ordinary game injuries only. Children never take part, and nothing here is switched on by itself.

Do you want this in this game?
keyed.HH.Underworld.Warn.Grim:
Grim content is everything of Dark content, and the hunt on prisoners no longer asks about your ideology. Organ buyers place orders with deadlines.

It appears as text and ordinary game injuries only. Children never take part, and nothing here is switched on by itself.

Do you want this in this game?
keyed.HH.Underworld.Warn.Hunt: You are about to allow hunting prisoners in a hunting ground. A prisoner is released into the ground with a head start; if he lasts the set time or reaches the fence line he is free, and his faction will hear about it either way. If he dies, his faction, your colonists and your guests will not forgive it.\n\nThis is shown as text only. Do you want to allow it?
keyed.HH.Underworld.Warn.Organ: A clinic counter buys harvested organs from anonymous donors at night. Ideologies that abhor the organ trade will hold it against you, and your Whispers rise with every sale.\n\nThis is shown as text only. Do you want to keep it?
keyed.HH.Underworld.Scandal.BackRoomFound.Titl: The back room was found out
keyed.HH.Underworld.Scandal.BackRoomFound.Text: A respectable guest opened the wrong door and saw what the house keeps behind it. By evening everyone in town will know.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Scandal.LeakedLedger.Title: Leaked ledger
keyed.HH.Underworld.Scandal.LeakedLedger.Text: A page of the fence's tally has found its way into the wrong hands. The goods are traced back to your counter.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Scandal.SecretCasinoRumour: Word has gone round that your house hides a casino for people who do not talk about it. High rollers are looking for the door.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Scandal.HonourAmongThieves: A gang speaks well of your house in the places where it counts.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Pit.Animals.Desc: Animals of your colony may fight here.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Pit.Volunteers.Desc: Colonists who like a fight (bloodlust or good melee) may volunteer. Volunteers never fight to the death.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Pit.Prisoners.Desc: Prisoners may be sent into the pit. Adults only.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Pit.Lethal.Desc: Bouts between prisoners and animals only end when one of them is down. Never for volunteers.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Pit.StartNow.Desc: Pick two fair fighters now and let the guests bet.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Pit.ArenaOpen: Arena open or too big: close the fence.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Pit.BoutAnnounced: A bout in the pit: {0} against {1}. Bets are open.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Pit.Won: {0} wins the bout. The house keeps {1} silver.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Pit.Draw: The bout ends without a winner. All stakes are returned.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Fence.Inspect: Stock: {0} items worth {1} silver. Cash box: {2} silver.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Fence.Fund.Desc: Move silver from the till into the fence's cash box, up to the limit in the settings.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Fence.Funded: {0} silver moved into the cash box.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Fence.Exposed: The goods came from {0}, and they know where they ended up.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Gang.Title: A gang at the door
keyed.HH.Underworld.Gang.Text: {0} people from {1} arrive quietly, nod at the staff and ask for the back room. They have money and they expect no questions.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Gang.Demand.Title: A friendly offer
keyed.HH.Underworld.Gang.Demand.Text: The leader of the gang from {0} leans on your counter. "A fine house. It would be a shame if something happened to it. For {1} silver we make sure nothing does."
keyed.HH.Underworld.Tour.IntelText: After an hour with {0} the gang left a note on the counter: a name, a place, a day. Somebody out there is planning something, and now you know a little more.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.Title: A crate at the dock
keyed.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.Text: A shuttle with its lights out has set down at the dock. A voice offers {0} items worth about {1} silver for {2}. No questions, no receipt.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.InspectText: An imperial patrol saw the lights at your dock and has written it down.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Hunt.Title: A hunting party
keyed.HH.Underworld.Hunt.Text: {0} hunters arrive with rifles and money. They paid {1} silver for the ground, and {2} animals were released into it.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Hunt.Prisoners.Desc: Let hunters hunt a prisoner released into the ground. Dark content only, with a fitting ideology.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Hunt.GateContent: Needs Dark or Grim content, confirmed.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Hunt.GatePrecept: The colony's ideology does not allow this.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Hunt.DeathTitle: A person died in the hunt
keyed.HH.Underworld.Hunt.DeathText: {0} did not survive the hunt. His people will hear of it, and so will everyone who was watching.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Hunt.FreedText: {0} lasted the time and walks free. The hunters went home angry; his faction will hear how it was done.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Organ.Sold: {0} organs collected at the clinic counter.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Organ.OrderText: A buyer wants a {0} within {1} days and pays a premium.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Organ.OrderDone: The order for a {0} was filled.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Organ.OrderMissed: The order for a {0} was not filled in time.

keyed.HH.Underworld.Page.Weights: Arrival weights: respectable x{0}, outlaws x{1}.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Page.Stats1: Fight pit: {0} bouts, {1} bets, house take {2} silver.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Page.Stats3: Lounge sessions {0}, gang visits {1}, landings {2}, hunts {3}, organs {4}.
keyed.HH.Underworld.Page.HighRollers: A rumour about a secret casino is drawing high rollers.

defs.ThingDef/HH_BackRoomDoor.label: back room door
defs.ThingDef/HH_BackRoomDoor.description: A plain-looking door with a good lock. Only your own people and shady guests can open it. A room behind nothing but back room doors does not count against the renown of your house.
defs.ThingDef/HH_FightPitMarker.label: fight pit marker
defs.ThingDef/HH_FightPitMarker.description: Marks a fenced arena around it. Build a closed fence (a gate is fine) at least 3 by 3 tiles inside, put this marker in the middle and the pit opens: volunteers, prisoners and animals fight, guests bet, the house keeps a tenth of the pool. Bouts end when someone yields or falls; to the death only from Dark content on, never for volunteers, never for children.
defs.ThingDef/HH_FenceCounter.label: fence's counter
defs.ThingDef/HH_FenceCounter.description: A scarred counter where a trusted fence buys stolen goods at forty percent of their value and sells them to shady buyers at seventy. The fence works from its own cash box, topped up from your till. The owners of the goods sometimes find out.
defs.ThingDef/HH_SmugglerDock.label: smuggler's dock
defs.ThingDef/HH_SmugglerDock.description: A bare landing pad with a shaded lamp. At night a crate sometimes comes down and a voice offers it cheap, no questions. Now and then somebody notices the lamp.
defs.ThingDef/HH_HuntingGroundMarker.label: hunting ground marker
defs.ThingDef/HH_HuntingGroundMarker.descript: Marks a fenced hunting ground (at least sixty tiles, closed). Rich hunters pay to shoot the animals they bring into it. With Dark content and the right ideology a prisoner can be the quarry; this is switched on separately, behind a warning.
defs.ThingDef/HH_OrganClinic.label: clinic counter
defs.ThingDef/HH_OrganClinic.description: A cold counter where harvested organs are put down for anonymous donors, who collect them at night and pay without a word. Only with Dark or Grim content. Ideologies that abhor the organ trade will hold it against you.
A dim room with sofas and a ledger nobody reads. Guests pay for a session; they only take what their ideology allows. Open at night.
Guests settle in on soft seats. At least two.
defs.JobDef/HH_FenceDeal.reportString: doing business at the fence's counter.
People were made to fight for bets and I stood close enough to hear it.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_SawFightPit_Bloodlust.stag: Now that was a proper fight.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_Interrogated.stages.0.desc: Strangers sat across from me for an hour and asked the same things over and over.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_OrganTradeOutrage.stages.0: They sell organs here. Under our roof. And nobody does anything about it.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_HuntOnPrisoners.stages.0.l: a person died in the hunt
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_HuntOnPrisoners.stages.0.d: They hunted a person on our grounds. I cannot stop thinking about it.

defs.IncidentDef/HH_GangVisit.label: gang visit
defs.IncidentDef/HH_HuntParty.label: hunt party
defs.IncidentDef/HH_SmugglerLanding.label: smuggler's landing
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Underworld_Discove: Internal key project. Finished when the stranger's offer is accepted. Never shown.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Underworld_1.label: the back room
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Underworld_1.descr: Back room doors, the fight pit, the fence's counter, the smuggler's dock and the drug lounge: everything a house needs for the trade that is not on the menu.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_TheHunt.label: the hunt
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_TheHunt.descriptio: A fenced hunting ground. Rich visitors pay well to shoot what you release into it. From Dark content on, a prisoner can be the quarry, behind a clear warning.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_BlackClinic.label: black clinic
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_BlackClinic.descri: A counter where anonymous donors buy harvested organs, no questions asked. Only with Dark or Grim content.
